sections.title: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
sections.text_before_clauses: The following sums shall be deemed as income received for the purposes of computing the income of an assessee—

clauses.text: sums deducted under this Chapter; and

income-tax paid outside India by way of deduction in respect of which an assessee is allowed a credit against the tax payable under this Act, except tax paid under section 392(2)(a) and tax deducted as per section 393(3) (Table: Sl. No. 5).
